ns2:course.label: Masterpieces Renaiss Lit
ns2:course.description: (ITAL 320) Reading of masterpieces of the 1400 and 1500s and a study of their predecessors and influence; nonconcentrators in Italian may read the works in translation; lectures are in English. Content rotates. Same as CWL 420, and MDVL 420. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours with consent of instructor. Prerequisite: Fulfillment of campus rhetoric requirement.
